complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Setup Next.js Project with TypeScript and Prisma
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the setup into: (1) Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript and ESLint, (2) Set up monorepo structure and shared types package, (3) Install and configure Prisma with PostgreSQL, (4) Configure environment variables for Neon.tech, (5) Set up ESLint and Prettier, (6) Establish directory structure for API and admin panel, (7) Configure TypeScript paths for monorepo imports.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This is a standard but multi-step project initialization task involving Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and monorepo configuration. Each step is well-documented in community guides and can be performed independently, but attention to detail is required to ensure smooth integration and future scalability[2][3][4].
